name: RunSubFlow
caption: Run SubFlow

configuration.description: Code of the called SubFlow (the flow's Code field, format [NAMESPACE.]CODE with A-Z, 0-9, _ and -, at most one '.', e.g. ACME.CUSTOMER_LOOKUP). This – not the flow No. – identifies the SubFlow across companies and environments. Compared upper-cased. No SmartFields.

Version pin: the internal ID of one of the called SubFlow's versions in this database (not a version number; meaningless in another database). Never a string – a string such as "1.2.0" can't be read in 27.0.39 and breaks import and the run. Leave it out in hand-written JSON: import (Create from file, template install, Update from template, Duplicate) pins it to the SubFlow's currently published version when that SubFlow exists in the target company. At run time the pin is required and must be a version of that SubFlow; there is no fallback to the published version. Next release (not in 27.0.39): written as the version number string ("1.2.0"); integer pins keep working.

Map of SubFlow input parameter name -> value expression (string). Keys must match the SubFlow trigger's configuration.inputs[].name (case-sensitive). Value inputs: any SmartText ({{slug_output}}, literals, formulas). Reference inputs: a flat wrapped selector {{name}} naming a reference in the calling flow (no dots, no [index]); anything else is passed as text. Undeclared keys are still passed in, but the editor drops them when the step is confirmed; missing keys leave the input empty.
Cosmetic: the called SubFlow's icon URL, written by the editor and mirrored to the step's top-level customIconUrl so the canvas shows the SubFlow's icon. Not used at run time.

outputs.name: <SubFlow output name>
outputs.when: Editor-generated: one entry per entry of configuration.outputs of the first Return SubFlow Output step in the resolved SubFlow version (pinned version if it belongs to the SubFlow, else the published one); type 'reference' with that entry's tableNo when declared "Reference"; names truncated to 30 chars. None when the Code is unknown. At run time every returned entry arrives as a value.

rules.check: configuration.subFlowCode must be non-empty and name a flow in this company.
rules.message: No SubFlow with Code "%1" exists in this company.

rules.check: subFlowCode must be a valid flow Code ([NAMESPACE.]CODE: A-Z 0-9 _ -, at most one '.', not first or last); any other value can never match a flow.
rules.message: No SubFlow with Code "%1" exists in this company.

rules.check: subFlowCode is at most 60 characters (longer values are truncated and won't match).
rules.message: No SubFlow with Code "%1" exists in this company.

rules.check: subFlowVersion, if present, must be an integer (a version record ID). A string such as "1.2.0" can't be converted in 27.0.39: import of the definition and the run fail with a JSON conversion error.
Status line of the step dialog (does not block saving): the Code must exist in this company with a published version. Confirming the dialog in this state saves empty inputBindings.
rules.message: SubFlow "%1" is not installed on this system, or has no published version. Install and publish it, then reopen this step.

rules.check: Status line of the step dialog (does not block saving): a Reference binding must point at a record of the table the SubFlow input declares (when it declares one).
rules.message: Parameter "%1" expects a reference to table %2, but the selected reference resolves to table %3.

rules.check: A newer published version of the SubFlow exists than the pinned one; the dialog offers a one-click switch.
rules.message: A newer version of this SubFlow is available.

rules.check: Save as template only (not normal publish): every referenced subFlowCode must exist with a published version. Save as template also removes subFlowVersion from every Run SubFlow step.
rules.message: Run-SubFlow step references SubFlow Code "%1", but no SubFlow with that Code is published on this tenant. Publish the missing SubFlow first, or remove the Run-SubFlow step before saving as template.

rules.check: The pin does not name an existing version (includes an absent pin, which reads as 0). No fallback to the published version.
rules.message: SubFlow %1 has no published version pinned in the call (version %2).

rules.check: The pin names a version of a different flow (e.g. JSON copied from another database without import re-pinning).
rules.message: SubFlow %1 is pinned to version %2, which belongs to a different flow. The call was imported from another system; open the step and pick the version to run.

rules.check: SubFlow nesting deeper than the AutoFlow Setup limit (default 32).
rules.message: Maximum SubFlow nesting depth (%1) exceeded. Call chain: %2.

rules.check: The pinned SubFlow version has an empty definition.
rules.message: SubFlow %1 version %2 has an empty definition.

rules.check: The pinned SubFlow version has no steps.
rules.message: SubFlow %1 version %2 has no trigger step.

rules.check: A step inside the SubFlow requests a deferred resume (Sleep etc.).
rules.message: Step %1 (%2) requested a deferred resume, but the flow is running synchronously. Use Sleep or other time-based deferral steps only outside of synchronous frames (Webhook sync phase or SubFlow body).

rules.check: A step inside the SubFlow requests an HTTP yield (Respond to webhook).
rules.message: Step %1 (%2) requested an HTTP yield, but it is running inside a SubFlow. Yield is only valid in the synchronous phase of a Webhook flow.

notes: Identification: the called flow is found by Code only; the flow No. never appears in the step. A SubFlow can't be published without a Code, and a published flow's Code can't be changed (only cleared with Reset Code, which breaks callers). Export writes the Code to the root 'code'; Save as template also writes it into the SubFlow trigger configuration ('subFlowCode'). Import restores it unless another flow in the company already owns it.

Import re-pinning (Create from file, template install, Update from template, Duplicate): every Run SubFlow step, also nested in edges, is re-pinned. If the Code exists in the target company, a pin that is one of that SubFlow's own versions is kept; anything else (absent, unknown, another flow's version) becomes the SubFlow's currently published version ID. If the Code is unknown or the SubFlow is unpublished, the step is left as imported (import still succeeds); open and confirm the step after publishing the SubFlow, or re-import. inputBindings are never changed by import.
Hand-written JSON: omit subFlowVersion and import the caller after the SubFlow is published in the target. This also works in the next release.
Next release (not in 27.0.39): subFlowVersion is written as the SubFlow's version number string ("1.2.0"), portable across environments; integer pins still resolve. Every flow then needs a Code.

Outputs are editor-generated from the resolved SubFlow version's first Return SubFlow Output step (document order, depth-first into edges). Names truncated to 30 characters. Downstream: {{<thisStepSlug>_<outputName>}}.

At run time every returned output is added as a value output carrying the text the SubFlow returned. A Reference-declared return arrives as the selector text, not a record; return a No. or SystemId and find the record in the caller.

Input projection: each binding becomes the SubFlow trigger output {{<subflowTriggerSlug>_<paramName>}} (normally {{trigger_<paramName>}}), cut to 30 characters in total. The 'required' flag on SubFlow inputs is not enforced.
Runs synchronously and inline in the caller's transaction (no commit between caller and SubFlow). Errors inside the SubFlow fail this step with the inner message unchanged.
Hidden from the generic step picker; every published SubFlow is offered as its own tile, which creates a Run SubFlow step pinned to its Code and published version.
